user.title: Hano
user.description: Set up people, devices and rooms in the Hano sidebar panel. Hano does not send any notification until an action is called.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Hano installation is needed.
abort.already_configured: Only one Hano installation is needed.

send.name: Send a notification
send.description: Send, update or start a notification cycle. An accepted call does not prove human reception.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to notify. Templates are supported by Home Assistant.

notification_id.name: Notification identifier
notification_id.description: Reuse to update an active notification or resolve it later. Empty generates an identifier.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: Image URL supported by the destination.

camera_entity_id.name: Camera
camera_entity_id.description: Attach an image from this camera when supported.

click_url.name: Open link
click_url.description: Link opened when the notification is tapped.

recipient_mode.name: Recipients
recipient_mode.description: Select configured people, all residents, current presence, or the nearest known position. No proximity entities are needed.

person_entity_ids.name: People
person_entity_ids.description: Configured people to include when using selected recipients.

mobile_device_ids.name: Companion devices
mobile_device_ids.description: Send directly to these Companion devices; their owner’s sleep state is not applied.

notify_entity_ids.name: Notify entities
notify_entity_ids.description: Send directly through these notify entities. Only supported options are accepted.

channels.name: Channels
channels.description: Mobile, immediate voice, and persistent Home Assistant notifications can be combined.

respect_sleep.name: Respect sleep
respect_sleep.description: Only send when configured sleep sensors confirm the person is awake. Independent of mobile priority.

delivery.name: Delivery
delivery.description: Send to eligible people now, or retain a pending delivery for each person until eligible.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Requested mobile interruption level. Device and operating system settings still apply.

ios_sound.name: iOS sound filename (optional)
ios_sound.description: Filename including .wav, .caf or .aiff. Import the sound into Companion on every selected iPhone first; it must last less than 30 seconds. Empty keeps the usual sound. Requires the mobile channel and only iOS destinations; incompatible with quiet priority. Leave reminders disabled for a single alert.

cycle_mode.name: Cycle
cycle_mode.description: Update preserves delivery tracking and does not repeat voice. New starts a new cycle.

expires_in.name: Expires after
expires_in.description: Seconds until global resolution. Zero means no expiration.

resolve_on_clear.name: Resolve when cleared
resolve_on_clear.description: Resolve everywhere when Companion reports a mobile dismissal. Not all devices report this event.

voice_mode.name: Voice destinations
voice_mode.description: Use selected speakers, or speakers in configured occupied rooms.

media_player_entity_ids.name: Media players
media_player_entity_ids.description: Speakers for explicit voice destinations. Voice is immediate and is never replayed after restart.

tts_entity_id.name: Text-to-speech engine
tts_entity_id.description: Override the default TTS engine configured in the Hano panel.

voice_message.name: Spoken message
voice_message.description: Optional spoken text; otherwise use the message.

volume.name: Announcement volume
volume.description: Only for explicitly enabled speakers supporting native announcement volume. Does not change ongoing music volume.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Notification icon when supported by the destination.

color.name: Color
color.description: Hexadecimal color such as #03A9F4 when supported.

timeout.name: Mobile display timeout
timeout.description: Seconds before mobile dismissal, where supported. Zero uses the device default.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Add freely named buttons. Use a link OR HA actions and optional resolution; links cannot confirm resolution.

reminder_interval.name: Reminder interval
reminder_interval.description: Seconds between mobile reminders (60–86400). Set interval and limit to 0 to disable. Requires a resolution-only acknowledgement button. Reading or opening is not reliably reported; one acknowledgement resolves the cycle for everyone. Sleep and presence apply. No voice replay or catch-up after restart.

reminder_limit.name: Maximum reminders per destination
reminder_limit.description: 1–100 additional attempts per mobile destination; 0 disables reminders with interval 0. Failed or uncertain sends are not retried. Updates preserve counts and restart the interval; a new cycle resets counts. Resolution or expiration cancels reminders.

preview.name: Preview a notification
preview.description: Calculate destinations and waiting reasons without sending or saving a notification.

resolve.name: Resolve a notification
resolve.description: Close the active cycle, cancel pending deliveries and request clearing everywhere. An absent or already closed notification is left unchanged.

notification_id.name: Notification identifier
notification_id.description: Identifier of the active notification to resolve.
